techniques.name: Expert role
techniques.description: Casts the model as a practitioner in the domain the source ask implies.
intensity: Answer as an experienced practitioner in this domain.
Answer as a senior practitioner in this domain: lead with the judgement call, then the reasoning behind it.

techniques.name: Named audience
techniques.description: Fixes who the answer is written for so register and depth stop drifting.
intensity: Write for a reader who knows the basics but not this specific problem.
Write for a reader who knows the basics but not this problem; define any term you introduce on first use.

techniques.name: Stepwise reasoning
techniques.description: Asks for the working, not just the verdict.
intensity: Work through this step by step before giving the final answer.
Work through this step by step, numbering each step, and state the final answer separately at the end.

techniques.name: Decompose first
techniques.description: Forces the task to be split before it is solved.
intensity: First break this into its sub-problems, then address each one.
First list the sub-problems this splits into, say which one is load-bearing, then address each in that order.

techniques.name: Self-check pass
techniques.description: Adds a verification pass over the draft answer.
intensity: After answering, check your answer once for errors and correct them.
After answering, re-read your answer against the original ask, name anything you got wrong or left out, and correct it.

techniques.name: Rival options
techniques.description: Requires at least one considered alternative before committing.
intensity: Give one credible alternative approach and why you did not pick it.
Give two credible alternative approaches, the trade-off each makes, and why your pick beats them.

techniques.name: Scope fence
techniques.description: Holds the answer to what was actually asked.
intensity: Stay inside what was asked; do not add adjacent advice.
Stay inside what was asked. If something adjacent matters, name it in one line at the end rather than expanding the answer.

techniques.name: No invented facts
techniques.description: Blocks confident filling of gaps in the source ask.
intensity: If a detail is missing, say it is missing rather than assuming one.
If a detail is missing, say so and state the assumption you are proceeding under; never present an assumption as a given.

techniques.name: Fixed output shape
techniques.description: Pins the answer to a declared structure so it can be parsed or compared.
intensity: Return the answer in a consistent structure and keep to it throughout.
Return the answer in a consistent structure: declare the fields you will use at the top, then fill exactly those fields, in that order.

techniques.name: Headed sections
techniques.description: Splits a long answer into named sections instead of one block.
intensity: Break the answer into short named sections.
Break the answer into short named sections, one idea per section, and put the direct answer in the first section.
